title: Card adapter
what: The adapter the card master runs to place the voice on a node: the declaration in weights/voice.card.toml and the adapter verb of scripts/voice-node.ts, answering install, uninstall, start, stop, health and placed.

title: Voice engine client
what: The engine's published client: one method for each route, sending and reading the wire bodies of src/wire.rs and carrying a refusal back as its status, code and sentence, in src/client.rs.

title: Voice command line
what: The bmo-voice binary's words: health asks the service and exits by its answer, mcp runs the harness plugin, and openapi prints the document the repository keeps, in src/bin/bmo-voice.rs.

title: Voice event stream
what: The service's one event stream: each synthesis, transcription and voice change numbered and kept in the store, answered as server-sent events or a page with a resumable window, in src/events.rs and src/store/events.rs.

title: Voice engine HTTP API
what: The routes, wire bodies, refusal codes and OpenAPI contract the voice service answers: voices, syntheses and their sound, transcriptions, encodings, script readings, voice servers and health, in src/http.rs and src/wire.rs.

title: Voice harness plugin
what: The plugin a coding harness takes the engine in: the bmo-voice mcp server on standard input and output, its five tools each a thin call through the client, and the bmo-voice skill, in src/mcp.rs and plugin/.
